title: Critique: the view leaves the central question where it was

statements.text: Amy Kind argues that Russellian monism fails to resolve the most central issue in the debate, whether consciousness is fundamental, since on the panpsychist form it is and on the panprotopsychist form it is not.

sources.quote: Russellian monism fails to resolve the most central issue in the debate: whether consciousness is a fundamental component of the universe
On Russellian panpsychism consciousness is a fundamental component of the universe, whereas on Russellian panprotopsychism it is not.
